summary: Activity stream checksum audit and user-metadata enrichment for SIEM handoff
description:
Issue summary:
Customer requests an ordered NDJSON export of tenant activity with per-event checksums and a separate user_metadata enrichment artifact. The export must be consumable by their SIEM ingest team and include cryptographic proofs (per-batch SHA-256 checksums + HMAC header), an ordered manifest, and an encrypted actor->pseudonym mapping file for downstream joins.

Impact:
Fintica's compliance team requires this deliverable for an upcoming regulator audit window. Without a verifiable export they cannot complete attestation and onboarding; high business impact (reporting deadline in 48 hours).

Environment:
- Tenant: fintica-prod (dedicated)
- Region: us-east
- Export pipeline: audit-export-batch-v2 -> s3-stage -> webhook-handoff

Ask / Acceptance criteria:
1) Export format: newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON) with guaranteed chronological ordering by event_timestamp.
2) Per-event fields: event_id, event_timestamp (RFC3339), tenant_id, actor_id (pseudonymized), event_type, payload_hash (sha256 hex).
3) Sidecar: user_metadata.json.enc containing reversible pseudonym map (actor_id -> salted_hash or encrypted identifier) encrypted with customer KMS public key.
4) Manifest: manifest.json containing batch_id, start_timestamp, end_timestamp, record_count, sha256_of_concatenated_event_hashes, and signed_hmac header.
5) Delivery: presigned S3 URL + separate manifest + encrypted sidecar delivered to customer SFTP endpoint.

Steps to reproduce / produce example payload (customer-provided):
Example NDJSON line:
{"event_id":"evt_20260310_0001","event_timestamp":"2026-03-10T14:02:17Z","tenant_id":"fintica-prod","actor_id":"pseud_3f2a","event_type":"model.invoke","payload_hash":"6b1b36cbb04b41490bfc0ab2bfa26f86"}

Desired manifest example:
{"batch_id":"batch-2026-03-10-14","start_ts":"2026-03-10T14:00:00Z","end_ts":"2026-03-10T14:15:00Z","record_count":10000,"concat_hash":"ab12...ef","hmac_header":"sha256=base64hmac=="}

Logs / Observations:
- Customer attached a sample 15MB export and an Excel mapping of expected fields (see attached on ticket).
- They indicated prior issues with ordering when using incremental snapshots (duplicates and slight clock skew).

Constraints / Security notes:
- Customer requests reversible pseudonymization for internal reconciliation; they will supply a public key for sidecar encryption.
- HMAC must be verifiable by Fintica; they want the HMAC key rotated weekly and must be able to validate with a provided KID.

Primary asks for Redwood team:
- Confirm feasibility and maximum single-batch size for guaranteed ordering semantics.
- Provide a temporary on-demand export procedure for audit within 48 hours.
- Provide production plan for scheduled exports + manifest signing and sidecar encryption.

investigation_notes:
- Staging export performed for fintica-prod (ingest commit 9ad7f2). Ordering guarantee preserved when using batch-writer v3 with write-ahead timestamp ordering.
- Verified sha256 calculation across events and concatenation matches sample manifest logic.
- Discovered edge-case: events with identical timestamps may reorder; we applied tie-breaker on event_id.
- Estimated workload: a 50MB compressed batch of ~70k events will compute concatenated hash in ~3-6s on current exporter pod.
- Blockers: automated weekly HMAC rotation not yet exposed to export service; requires small infra change and KMS grant. PR opened to add KMS rotate-read access: github.com/redwoodinference/infra/pull/183
resolution_notes:
Temporary workaround delivered: one-time point-in-time export completed 2026-03-12 17:55 UTC. Artifacts delivered to customer SFTP endpoint: presigned-s3-url (events.ndjson.gz), manifest.json (signed by Redwood), user_metadata.json.enc (encrypted with customer public key).
Next steps:
1) Close short-term gap: merge PR infra/pull/183 to enable automated HMAC rotation (owner: infra).
2) Product to approve KID exposure in manifest for long-term automation (owner: Product Manager).
3) Implement scheduled export job with per-batch HMAC header and KID rotation (owner: ingest team).
4) Post-delivery follow-up: Fintica to validate checksums and confirm acceptance by 2026-03-13 12:00 UTC.
